name: Wasabi
label: Wasabi S3-compatible object storage
description: Wasabi S3-compatible object storage. Official API https://docs.wasabi.com/docs/wasabi-api. One node; pick operation. Handler: OfficialApiNode + api_spec.json. Auth is AWS SigV4 (access_key + secret_key). Host is https://s3.{region}.wasabisys.com. The generic s3.wasabisys.com host may allow GET but not PUT/DELETE. Do not claim unexpected egress pricing in product copy.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets on this port.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. Accepted: bucket_create, bucket_list, object_put, object_get, object_delete, object_list.

schema.label: list-type
schema.description: S3 list API version for object_list. Use 2 for ListObjectsV2. Example: 2.

schema.label: prefix
schema.description: Key prefix filter for object_list. Example: invoices/2026/.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Object bytes for object_put (S3 PUT). Platform file block {mime_type, source, data, name}. Required on object_put. Sent as the raw body.

schema.label: delimiter
schema.description: S3 list delimiter for object_list. Example: / to group common prefixes.

schema.label: max-keys
schema.description: S3 list max keys for object_list. Example: 1000.

schema.label: continuation-token
schema.description: S3 list-type=2 continuation token from a previous object_list.

schema.label: start-after
schema.description: S3 list-type=2 start-after key for object_list.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status, http_status, data, file?}. Secrets redacted. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Downloaded or converted bytes. Platform file ref-id (sq-file: / sq-ref:gridfs:). Never inline bytes or base64 as the stored type.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official HTTP verb for this invoke. listen/webhook_listen are ingress — use a BPMN message event.

configurationParameters.label: Secret Key
configurationParameters.description: Wasabi secret key used to sign SigV4. StudioQuack secret binding. Never log. Never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Access Key
configurationParameters.description: Wasabi access key used as the SigV4 credential. StudioQuack secret. Never logged. Never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Region
configurationParameters.description: Wasabi region for SigV4 signing and host s3.{region}.wasabisys.com (us-east-1, eu-central-1, …). Official: https://docs.wasabi.com/docs/service-urls-for-wasabis-storage-regions.
